news.headline: Abivax shares rebound 4%, among the strongest gainers in the SBF 120
news.summary: Paris-listed Abivax rose about 4% on Nov 25, one of the top gainers in the SBF 120, as it continued to recover from the Scorpion short-report sell-off. The company also added more investor meetings ahead of the U.S. filing.

news.headline: Abivax announces additional investor fireside chat as obefazimod advances toward NDA submission
news.summary: Abivax added a virtual fireside chat hosted by LifeSci Capital on Nov 30 at 4:00 pm ET, on top of its Evercore ISI (Dec 2) and Piper Sandler (Dec 3) appearances. It reiterated that the obefazimod UC NDA will be submitted by year-end 2026. The extra slot gives management another venue to answer the short-seller safety claims.

news.headline: Wedbush reaffirms Abivax at Neutral, sees heightened FDA scrutiny for obefazimod
news.summary: Wedbush kept its Neutral rating after the Scorpion short report, expecting the skin-cancer debate to bring heightened FDA scrutiny of obefazimod's safety during review. The firm has flagged the risk of a boxed warning on the label since the Phase 3 data.

news.headline: Abivax stock surges after rejecting short seller claims
news.summary: Abivax shares rebounded about 10% in Paris on Monday to roughly EUR 69 after the company called Scorpion Capital's report "factually inaccurate and misleading", noting the Phase 3 skin-cancer cases were in older patients, some with risk factors such as prior thiopurine use. The rebound recovered part of Friday's 17% drop, and the company reiterated its year-end NDA plan.

news.headline: French biotech rejects short seller's cancer-risk claims after shares plunge 17%
news.summary: Abivax shares rose about 10% on Monday after the company called Scorpion Capital's phototoxicity and skin-cancer allegations against obefazimod factually inaccurate and based on studies the short seller funded itself. Abivax reiterated that it will file the U.S. NDA by year-end and said it will give further updates after reviewing the report.

news.headline: Abivax Statement on Short Seller Report
news.summary: Abivax called Scorpion Capital's report full of factually inaccurate and misleading statements, noted the short seller's disclosed financial interest, and said it stands behind the ABTECT program and its year-end NDA plan while reviewing the report in detail.

news.headline: Ulcerative colitis trial results will support a U.S. drug application, Abivax says
news.summary: Abivax said its Phase 3 ABTECT data remain sufficient to support the U.S. NDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, which it still plans to submit by year-end 2026, pushing back on the short report.

catalysts.label: LifeSci Capital virtual fireside chat
catalysts.detail: Added on Nov 24: virtual fireside chat hosted by LifeSci Capital at 4:00 pm ET, the first investor Q&A after the Scorpion short report. The webcast will be posted on the Abivax IR site.

catalysts.label: Evercore ISI Healthcare Conference fireside chat
catalysts.detail: Miami, 7:55-8:15am ET fireside chat at the Evercore ISI Healthcare Conference (Nov 30-Dec 2).

catalysts.label: Piper Sandler Healthcare Conference fireside chat
catalysts.detail: New York (conference Dec 1-3), fireside chat Thursday Dec 3, 8:00-8:25am ET; the last listed fall-tour appearance before the year-end obefazimod UC NDA submission.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial update
catalysts.detail: Listed for December 14, 2026 on Abivax's investor-relations financial calendar; expect the cash position and an update on the NDA submission timing.

catalysts.label: NDA submission for obefazimod (UC)
catalysts.detail: Company-guided first NDA submission to the FDA by end of 2026, reiterated in July (pre-NDA meeting) and September (H1 results). Submission before the Mar-2027 call expiry is the key near-term event.

catalysts.label: FDA filing acceptance and PDUFA date
catalysts.detail: FDA typically decides on filing within ~60 days of submission and sets a PDUFA goal date; if submitted in December, acceptance would land around February-March 2027, close to the call's March 2027 expiry.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b topline in Crohn's disease (obefazimod)
catalysts.detail: Company-guided topline readout of the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial in mid-2027; after the Mar-2027 call expiry but a key second-indication driver.

pulse: Abivax has a complete positive Phase 3 package in ulcerative colitis (induction and Week-44 maintenance), constructive pre-NDA feedback and cash into Q4 2029, and reiterated on Nov 24 that it will file the obefazimod NDA by year-end 2026. The Nov 20 Scorpion Capital short report (skin-cancer and mechanism claims) sent the Paris shares down 17%. They have since recovered part of that, rising about 10% on Nov 23 and another 4% on Nov 25 after the company rebutted the claims, although Wedbush (Neutral) expects heightened FDA safety scrutiny. Next up are the added LifeSci fireside chat on Nov 30, Evercore and Piper Sandler on Dec 2-3, the Dec 14 financial update and confirmation that the NDA goes in well before the March 2027 call expiry.
